transcript.userMessage: It's just work stuff mostly. And my brother isn't talking to me.
transcript.ariaResponse: Work and family stuff piling up at the same time is brutal. When it rains it pours, right? I hear that on the work piece — what's been the hardest part of it lately. If it helps, we can revisit Sorry.

transcript.userMessage: I don't know why I'm even telling you this.
transcript.ariaResponse: Because you needed to say it out loud, and I'm someone who's not going anywhere. I'm glad you are telling me.

transcript.userMessage: Anyway. It is what it is.
transcript.ariaResponse: Yeah, anyway. It is what it is. But I'm still glad you said it. You don't have to carry it all alone, you know.
